meta.naslov: TOPICA — cabinet design software with cut lists, built for cabinet makers
meta.opis: TOPICA is kitchen design software for cabinet makers on Windows: draw the room, place cabinets from the catalog, and get 3D, a millimetre-exact cut list, hardware and price. Free trial.
meta.og_naslov: TOPICA — from the room to the cut list
meta.og_opis: Cabinet design software for cabinet makers: room, catalog cabinets, 3D, millimetre-exact cut list and price. Free trial.
meta.og_alt: Topi the mascot measuring a cabinet next to the words TOPICA — from the room to the cut list
meta.ld_opis: Windows software for designing custom panel furniture (kitchens, wardrobes, cabinets) for joinery workshops: room in 3D, catalog cabinets built to the European standard, millimetre-exact cut list, hardware and price.

jezik.napomena_program: The program is currently available in Serbian and English. This language is coming.
jezik.predlog_tekst: This page is also available in English.

hero.naslov: From the room to the cut list.
hero.tekst: TOPICA is cabinet design software built for cabinet makers: draw the room, line up cabinets along the wall, and the program knows the construction and instantly gives you 3D, a millimetre-exact cut list, hardware and a price.
hero.sitno: Windows 10/11 · Serbian and English · the trial is free
hero.topi_alt: Topi, the plush mascot of TOPICA, measuring a base kitchen cabinet with an open door using a tape measure
hero.prozor_alt: TOPICA, 3D view of a kitchen in a room: base and wall cabinets with oak fronts along the wall, with the base run at 3200 mm and 400 mm of free space

cinjenice.naslov: Why software for cabinet makers, not a drawing tool

1.tekst: Every panel gets its exact size from the real cabinet construction, not from a sketch by eye.

2.tekst: Frameless carcass, edge banding, 35 mm cup hinges, drawers and plinth from the catalog. Nothing to set up again.

3.tekst: Same sizes on one line, grouped by material. Copy it and send it to the panel saw.

kako.naslov: Three steps to a cut list.

1.tekst: Enter the walls, ceiling height, window and services. The room is in 3D right away, with the floor and walls your customer actually has.
1.alt: TOPICA, step 1: a 3600 × 3000 mm room with floor and wall choices, grey laminate and tiles behind the kitchen

2.tekst: Base, wall, tall, sink, oven, corner. They snap to the wall and to the neighbour, and you change sizes live, to the millimetre.
2.alt: TOPICA, step 2: a 600 × 720 × 560 mm base cabinet with a door against the wall, with dimensions to the neighbour and the properties panel

3.naslov: Read the cut list and the price
3.tekst: The program knows the construction: sides, bottom, rails, back, front. Cut list, hardware and price are always current, with no “recalculate” button.
3.alt: TOPICA, step 3: the “By size” cut list for one cabinet, 8 panels grouped by material with size, thickness, edging and price

korpus.naslov: One cabinet. Every panel to the millimetre.

natpis.1: A 600 × 720 × 560 mm base cabinet, the kind every workshop builds.
natpis.2: The program takes it apart into panels and gives each one its exact size, edging and thickness.
natpis.3: The panels lie down on the sheet as a cutting plan: white chipboard, oak decor, hardboard.
natpis.4: And the “By size” cut list is ready to copy and send to the panel saw.

korpus.noscript_alt: TOPICA, “By size” cut list for a 600 × 720 × 560 mm base cabinet
korpus.posle: The program does this for every cabinet in the kitchen the moment you set it against the wall.

niz.naslov: Build the run, the program finishes it.
niz.tekst: Cabinets snap to each other and to the wall, and the worktop and plinth land on top with the overall size, no drawing needed.

mogucnosti.naslov: Furniture design software that knows joinery.
mogucnosti.tekst: Kitchens, fitted wardrobes and cabinets. You decide sizes and decors; the program does the construction and the maths.

1.tekst: Type width, height and depth or drag the slider. Dimensions to the wall, to the neighbour and from the floor are always visible.
1.alt: A cabinet in 3D with dimensions 600, 720 and 560 mm and markers to the wall, to the neighbour and from the floor

2.tekst: Every cabinet type comes with construction to the European standard, System 32.

3.tekst: Same sizes on one line, by material. The first dimension is the grain direction.

4.tekst: Oak, white, marble or your own decor from a photo. Whatever you change, you see at once, in a 3D kitchen design your customer understands.

5.naslov: Plinth, worktop and end panels, automatically
5.tekst: They are built over the selected cabinets and travel with them when you move them.

6.tekst: Enter your own prices for boards, edging, hardware and labour. The program adds it up per project; you make the quote.
6.alt: Workshop settings: labour per unit 3000 RSD, margin 20 %

7.tekst: A project is one file on your computer. E-mail it to a colleague.

pitanja.naslov: What cabinet makers ask before trying it.

1.p: Which Windows does it run on?
1.o: Windows 10 and Windows 11, 64-bit. The program is small and fast; it runs on an ordinary workshop laptop.

2.o: No. The program works offline and without an account. A project is a single file on your computer.

3.p: Which boards and materials does it support?
3.o: 18 mm chipboard for carcass and fronts, 0.45 and 1 mm edging, 3 mm hardboard for backs; thicknesses and edging are changed in the workshop settings. Pick a decor from the list or add your own.

4.p: What do I get at the end?
4.o: A cut list per cabinet and per material, the “By size” view for copying, a hardware list, board usage, price and PDF printing.

5.o: Serbian and English. You switch the language inside the program.

6.o: Yes. New versions come out regularly, and the trial can always be downloaded again from this page.

dno.naslov: Try it on your next project.
dno.tekst: Windows 10/11. No account, no card. A cut list for your first cabinet in five minutes.

preuzimanje.meta_naslov: Download the free TOPICA trial for Windows
preuzimanje.meta_opis: Free trial of the cabinet design and cut list software. Windows 10/11, 64-bit, no account. Three installation steps.
preuzimanje.tekst: Free, no account and no card. Installation takes a minute, and you'll have your first cabinet with a cut list in five.
preuzimanje.email_naslov: Leave your e-mail if you like (optional)
preuzimanje.email_tekst: We only send new versions and the price when it's out. No ads, one-click unsubscribe.
preuzimanje.z2: An ordinary workshop laptop is enough: 4 GB of memory and graphics that can run 3D in a browser.
preuzimanje.z3: Not needed. The program works offline and creates no account.
preuzimanje.k2: If Windows asks whether you trust the program, click “More info”, then “Run anyway”.
preuzimanje.k3: Open TOPICA from the desktop. Create your first project: enter the room sizes and place the first cabinet.
preuzimanje.slika_placeholder: Space for a screenshot of this step (added by the owner)
preuzimanje.upozorenje: The program is not yet digitally signed, so on first launch Windows shows a blue “Windows protected your PC” screen. This is normal for new, unsigned programs: click “More info”, then “Run anyway”. We are obtaining a signature and the warning will disappear.
preuzimanje.pomoc: Stuck? Write to us, we reply the same day.

hvala.meta_naslov: Thank you — the TOPICA trial is downloading
hvala.meta_opis: The TOPICA trial download has started. Three steps to get going.
hvala.tekst: If it didn't start by itself:
hvala.k1: Install the program (at the Windows warning: “More info”, then “Run anyway”).
hvala.k2: Create a new project and enter the room sizes: width, depth and ceiling height.
